Default control settings for RABFA

Source: R/rabfa.R
rabfa_control.Rd

Default control settings for RABFA

Usage

rabfa_control(
  nu1 = 0,
  nu2 = 1,
  eta = 10,
  eps = 0.2,
  sigma_m2 = 100,
  phi = 1,
  mh_sd = 1,
  thin = 1
)

Arguments

nu1

Prior mean of the log shrinkage parameters; exp(nu1) is the typical Laplace rate. Larger values shrink loadings more (default 0).

nu2

Prior variance scale of the log shrinkage parameters. It sets how much each loading's shrinkage can adapt to the data (default 1).

eta

Concentration of the graph prior: confidence in the graph (default 10, as in the paper).

eps

Controls the strength of the prior correlation between neighbouring shrinkage parameters (default 0.2, as in the paper).

sigma_m2

Prior variance of the feature means (default 100).

phi

Prior parameter for the noise precisions (default 1).

mh_sd

Standard deviation of the random-walk proposal for the log shrinkage parameters (default 1).

thin

Keep every thin-th draw after burn-in (default 1).

Value

A named list.
